papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: Introduces the Transformer architecture, which relies on attention mechanisms instead of recurrent or convolutional layers for sequence modeling.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.abstract: Introduces BERT, a bidirectionally trained Transformer model that improves language understanding across a range of NLP tasks.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.abstract: Presents GPT-3 and demonstrates that large autoregressive language models can perform many tasks from natural-language instructions and a small number of examples.

papers.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
papers.abstract: Describes GPT-4, a large multimodal model, and reports evaluations of its capabilities, limitations, and performance on professional and academic benchmarks.

papers.title: Sparks of Artificial General Intelligence: Early Experiments with GPT-4
papers.abstract: Investigates GPT-4's performance across diverse tasks and discusses whether its capabilities show early signs of general intelligence.

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Surveys the development of large language models, covering architectures, training, adaptation, evaluation, applications, and open challenges.

papers.title: On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Examines foundation models trained on broad data and discusses their capabilities, societal effects, risks, and research opportunities.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.abstract: Combines a pretrained sequence-to-sequence model with a dense retrieval system to improve generation on knowledge-intensive tasks.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Shows that prompting sufficiently large language models to produce intermediate reasoning steps can improve performance on multi-step reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
papers.abstract: Introduces self-consistency decoding, which samples multiple reasoning paths and selects a consistent answer to improve reasoning accuracy.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.abstract: Introduces a framework in which language models interleave reasoning with actions to interact with external environments and tools.

papers.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Proposes exploring multiple intermediate reasoning paths as a tree, allowing language models to evaluate and revise candidate solutions.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.abstract: Introduces Direct Preference Optimization, a method for aligning language models with preference data without explicitly fitting a separate reward model.

papers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
papers.abstract: Presents an approach to training AI assistants using a set of principles and AI-generated feedback to improve helpfulness and harmlessness.

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.abstract: Introduces a method for teaching language models to call external tools such as calculators, search engines, and question-answering systems.

papers.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Describes InstructGPT, trained using demonstrations and human preference feedback to better follow user instructions.

papers.title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
papers.abstract: Studies training reward models to distinguish correct and incorrect solutions to mathematical word problems and improve answer selection.

papers.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
papers.abstract: Investigates process supervision for mathematical reasoning and finds that feedback on individual solution steps can improve reliability.

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
papers.abstract: Describes training techniques, data, and reinforcement learning methods that improve mathematical reasoning in open language models.

papers.title: ToRA: A Tool-Integrated Reasoning Agent for Mathematical Problem Solving
papers.abstract: Presents a mathematical reasoning agent that combines language-model reasoning with external computational tools to solve problems.

papers.title: AlphaGeometry: An Olympiad-Level AI System for Geometry
papers.abstract: Introduces a neuro-symbolic system that combines a language model with a symbolic deduction engine to solve complex geometry problems.

papers.title: Advancing Mathematics by Guiding Human Intuition with AI
papers.abstract: Explores how machine learning can help mathematicians develop conjectures and investigate mathematical structures.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Describes reinforcement-learning approaches for developing reasoning capabilities in language models and reports results on reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
papers.abstract: Documents the architecture, training strategy, and evaluation of DeepSeek-V3, a large mixture-of-experts language model.

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.abstract: Presents Llama 2 language models and describes their training, safety tuning, evaluation, and chat-oriented variants.

papers.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
papers.abstract: Introduces the LLaMA family and studies how high-quality training data can produce competitive language models at different scales.

papers.title: Mixtral of Experts
papers.abstract: Introduces Mixtral, a sparse mixture-of-experts language model that activates a subset of its parameters for each token.

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Introduces latent diffusion models, which perform diffusion in a compressed representation to make high-resolution image synthesis more efficient.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.abstract: Presents a probabilistic diffusion framework for generating data by learning to reverse a gradual noise-adding process.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.abstract: Introduces generative adversarial networks, in which a generator and discriminator are trained competitively to model data.

papers.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
papers.abstract: Introduces variational autoencoders as a scalable method for learning latent-variable generative models using variational inference.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.abstract: Introduces CLIP, which learns transferable visual representations by training images and their natural-language descriptions together.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.abstract: Applies Transformer architectures to image patches and demonstrates strong image-classification performance at scale.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.abstract: Introduces residual connections that allow very deep neural networks to be trained effectively for image recognition.

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract: Introduces Adam, an adaptive optimization algorithm that uses estimates of first and second moments of gradients during training.

papers.title: Improving Neural Networks by Preventing Co-adaptation of Feature Detectors
papers.abstract: Introduces dropout as a regularization technique that reduces co-adaptation of feature detectors in neural networks.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.abstract: Studies empirical relationships between model size, dataset size, compute, and language-model performance.

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Examines compute-optimal language-model training and argues that model size and training-token count should scale together.

papers.title: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Reviews capabilities that appear unexpectedly as language models scale and discusses their implications for evaluating model behavior.

papers.title: Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?
papers.abstract: Examines whether apparent emergent abilities in language models may partly result from evaluation metrics and the way performance is measured.

papers.title: Neural Turing Machines
papers.abstract: Introduces a neural architecture with an external differentiable memory that can be read from and written to by a neural network.

papers.title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
papers.abstract: Treats a neural network's hidden state as a continuous dynamical system and uses differential-equation solvers to compute model outputs.

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Reviews graph neural network architectures, learning methods, applications, and challenges in processing graph-structured data.
papers.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

papers.title: Deep Learning in Neural Networks: An Overview
papers.abstract: Provides a broad historical and technical overview of deep learning in neural networks, including major architectures and learning advances.

papers.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
papers.abstract: Introduces a selective state-space model designed for efficient sequence modeling with linear scaling in sequence length.

papers.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
papers.abstract: Studies how language models use information in long input contexts and finds that relevant information in the middle can be harder to retrieve.
papers.publisher: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.journal: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics

papers.title: A Survey on Hallucination in Large Language Models: Principles, Taxonomy, Challenges, and Open Questions
papers.abstract: Surveys hallucination in large language models, covering definitions, causes, evaluation approaches, mitigation methods, and open research questions.

papers.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
papers.abstract: Presents simulated agents that use memory, reflection, and planning to produce believable behavior in an interactive virtual environment.

papers.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Introduces an open-ended agent that uses a language model to explore, acquire skills, and improve its behavior in the Minecraft environment.

papers.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
papers.abstract: Introduces a benchmark that evaluates language models on resolving real software engineering issues drawn from GitHub repositories.
